data.fund_type: An open ended fund of fund scheme investing in BlackRock Global Funds – Nutrition Fund
data.investment_objective: The primary investment objective of the Scheme is to seek capital appreciation by investing predominantly in units of BlackRock Global Funds Nutrition Fund (BGF - NF). The Scheme may, at the discretion of the Investment Manager, also invest in the units of other similar overseas mutual fund schemes, which may constitute a significant part of its corpus. The Scheme may also invest a certain portion of its corpus in money market securities and/or money market/liquid schemes of DSP Mutual Fund, in order to meet liquidity requirements from time to time. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: 1. Units of BGF – NF or other similar overseas mutual fund scheme(s): 95% to 100% 2. Money market securities and/or units of money market/liquid schemes of DSP Mutual Fund: 0% to 5%; For detailed asset allocation pattern, please refer to the Scheme Information Document
